# `aube diag`

- **Usage:** `aube diag <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Diagnostic trace analysis (compare/analyze JSONL traces)

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube --diag full install
aube diag analyze aube-diag.jsonl
```

Read the [workflow guide](/troubleshooting) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
